0.original: Varshahn wears a look of quiet determination.

24.original: Gather information on the hydromantic terraces.

26.original: Search for the clever voidsent in carcere IV.

48.original: Wherever I turn, there's Darkness as far as I can perceive; the only source of Light here is ourselves. The opposite was true in the First.

49.original: It seems the minions are content to gawp for now. Let's carry on.

50.original: The warding scale exhibits no change. It should be safe to remain here and begin our search.

51.original: But whither now? I would sense Azdaja were she remotely near, but there is nothing...

52.original: Might you not call to her? Let her know that you have come.

53.original: Alas, this vessel is not capable of calling across vast distances. For that, I require my true form.

54.original: And even were it possible, a dragon's call is borne upon aether. 'Tis liable to draw more voidsent to us.

56.original: In any case, there's little exploration to be done while we are confined to this isolated isle.

57.original: I propose we begin by learning what we can from the castle's occupants. An understanding of their ways may prove useful to our cause.

58.original: Very well. Let's hope a few of them are capable of speech.

59.original: Let all remain vigilant while we go about our inquiries. We reconvene afterwards.

60.original: Like the prevailing tongue in Norvrandt, the language of this world bears a resemblance to our own. It may be assumed that they share a common ancestor.

61.original: This one does naught but stare...

62.original: Some seem willing enough to converse. Whether they have the ability to do so is another matter...

65.original: The creature snarls and glares at you. It is unlikely that you will learn anything from it.

67.original: What enticing aether you have... Give me some! Give me some!

68.original: Awww... If only I were stronger, I'd be able to eat you...

69.original: Fine, fine. I'll find someone else to eat... <grumble>

70.original: While able to communicate, this one seems to think only of feeding. Better to take your inquiries elsewhere.

71.original: I want to eat you. I mustn't eat you. I want to eat you. I mustn't eat you...

72.original: The mistress's eyes are beauteous! Sublime! To bask in her gaze is bliss!

73.original: But now she's gone... Never again will I feel her gaze...

74.original: No mistress. No orders. What am I to do now? What am I to do now?

75.original: The creature mutters endlessly to itself, not sparing you so much as a glance.

76.original: No mistress. No orders. What am I to do now? What am I to do now?

77.original: I serve! I obey! Please don't eat me!

78.original: A...dragon? What's that? Does it taste good? I don't know anything about it. Don't know about anything.

79.original: But the one we caught recently, they seemed to know lots.

80.original: We threw them in the dungeon, but clever ones are tasty. They might have been eaten already.

81.original: You've learned all you can from this voidsent. If you look in the dungeon, you may be able to find the clever one it mentioned.

82.original: We threw the clever one in the dungeon, but clever ones are tasty. If I had the chance, I don't think I could resist...

83.original: I have nothing to share. While those I approached had no will to fight, neither were they capable of holding a conversation worth the name.

84.original: My experience was much the same. Lower-rung voidsent tend to have lower intelligence, 'twould seem.

85.original: A pity Scarmiglione is dead. He was talkative at least.

87.original: A clever voidsent in the dungeon...

88.original: That would be the area in which we emerged.

90.original: Let's take ourselves back there and find this voidsent─preferably before its fellows make a meal of it.

92.original: There appears to be someone within...

93.original: I mislike the feel of this. Stay on your guard.

94.original: Could this be the clever voidsent?

95.original: Zenos's avatar, eh? What are the odds.

96.original: We still know little about her, but for now I'm glad we found someone who can do more than moan for aether.

97.original: I assume the dungeon was reserved for those intended for the mistress's consumption.

98.original: 'Tis fortunate that we came here when we did. Fateful, even.

99.original: When I served Zenos, my mind was shrouded in haze. But one thing was always clear─his obsession with the “friend.”

100.original: What the word means, I do not know exactly. I know only that it referred to you, and that yours was an important existence.

101.original: As much as one might expect the unexpected, I doubt any of us could have foreseen this turn of events.

102.original: She seems different from other voidsent─at least those we've met. And the change we witnessed, I suspect, is due to your crystal purging the excess Darkness in her.

103.original: Even so, she still harbors a great deal of Darkness. I'm very keen to hear what she can tell us─about herself and about her world.
